# Option reference (generated)

<!-- Generated by `ultrafast reference -o docs/reference/options.md` from the engine's option registry. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every key the engine reads, with its JSON type, SI unit, default and meaning. The same registry produces the
JSON Schemas (`schemas/`, [Schemas](schema.md)) and the unknown-key warnings, so this page is complete by construction.
Units: the key suffix names the unit (`lengthM` metres, `durationFwhmS` seconds, `gddFs2` fs²).

## System file

Top-level keys of a `.ufs` system file.

An optical system: a chain of elements. More: [system-file.md](system-file.md)

| key | type | unit | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `format` | string |  |  | "ultrafast-system" |
| `version` | integer |  | 2 | Format version |
| `name` | string |  |  | Name of the system |
| `description` | string |  |  | Free text |
| `source` | object |  |  | Provenance of the file (written by exporters, e.g. the zemax plugin); free-form |
| `sampling` | object (`samplingWavelengths`) |  |  | Wavelengths of all per-wavelength arrays in the file |
| `environment` | object (`environment`) |  |  | Air of the laboratory and the index reference of quoted data |
| `materials` | object |  |  | Materials defined in this file, by name (docs/reference/materials.md) |
| `coatings` | object |  |  | Coatings defined in this file, by name (docs/reference/coatings.md) |
| `substrates` | object |  |  | Mirror substrates defined in this file, by name: material, thicknessM, backCoating / backReflectance, wedgeDeg (docs/reference/coatings.md#substrate-echoes) |
| `inputBeam` | model (beam) |  |  | Default beam for nonlinear elements without one |
| `elements` | array of `element` |  |  | The beam path, in order **Required.** |
| `overrides` | array of `override` |  |  | Changes to models or values (docs/reference/models.md#overrides) |

## Pulse

`run.pulse`.

The input pulse (docs/reference/run-spec.md#pulse).

| key | type | unit | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `shape` | `"gaussian"` \| `"sech2"` \| `"superGaussian"` \| `"spectrum"` |  | gaussian | Pulse shape |
| `centerWavelengthM` | number | m |  | Carrier wavelength (for spectrum: default = intensity-weighted mean) |
| `centerWavelengthNm` | number | nm |  | Carrier wavelength in nm (alternative) |
| `durationFwhmS` | number | s |  | Transform-limited intensity FWHM |
| `durationFwhmFs` | number | fs |  | Transform-limited FWHM in fs (alternative) |
| `bandwidthFwhmM` | number | m |  | Spectral FWHM (alternative to the duration) |
| `bandwidthFwhmNm` | number | nm |  | Spectral FWHM in nm |
| `order` | integer |  | 2 | superGaussian order |
| `energyJ` | number | J |  | Pulse energy |
| `averagePowerW` | number | W |  | Average power (with repRateHz) |
| `peakPowerW` | number | W |  | Peak power (alternative) |
| `repRateHz` | number | Hz |  | Repetition rate |
| `chirp` | object (`chirp`) |  |  | Spectral phase about the carrier: gddS2/todS3/fodS4 or gddFs2/todFs3/fodFs4 |
| `polarization` | any |  | "x" | "x", "y", "45", "-45", "rcp", "lcp", {angleDeg, ellipticity} or [exRe, exIm, eyRe, eyIm] |
| `spectrum` | object (`pulseSpectrum`) |  |  | Measured spectrum (shape: spectrum): wavelengthsM + intensity (+ phaseRad), or csv |
| `delayS` | number | s | 0 | Time offset |
| `pedestal` | any |  |  | Pedestal / contrast components: one object or a list (replica, prePulse, postPulse, ase, phaseNoise, exponential) |
| `noise` | object (`pulseNoise`) |  |  | Quantum noise on the input: one photon per frequency mode with random phase (supercontinuum coherence, parametric seeding) |

## Grid

`run.grid`.

The time/frequency grid (docs/reference/run-spec.md#grid).

| key | type | unit | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `auto` | boolean |  | true | Size the grid from pulse and system |
| `n` | integer |  | 4096 | Number of samples (with auto: a minimum) |
| `windowS` | number | s | 30 x the transform limit | Time window |
| `windowPs` | number | ps |  | Time window in ps |
| `maxN` | integer |  | 4194304 | Largest allowed n |
| `snapCarrier` | boolean |  | true | Put the carrier on the frequency grid |
| `spectralMargin` | number |  | auto | Spectral span factor |
| `minSpanFraction` | number |  | 0.1 | Nonlinear runs: minimum half-span / carrier |
| `minPointsPerFwhm` | number |  | 12 | Samples across the transform-limited FWHM |
| `satelliteLevel` | number |  | 1e-8 | Weakest combination of ghost / replica satellites the window makes room for (relative intensity); weaker multi-satellite combinations may wrap around the window |
| `extendForSatellites` | boolean |  | false | Manual window (auto false): grow the window, keeping dt, so that ghosts, echoes and pedestal replicas above satelliteLevel fit |
| `strict` | boolean |  | false | A ghost, echo or pedestal that wraps around the window is an error instead of a warning |
| `tail` | any |  | false | Delayed-light ledger: true, or {windowS, warnEnergyFraction, exactSteps (every linear element takes the exact long-grid step; default false), crossPhase (first-order cross-phase of the tail by the main pulse in nonlinear elements; default true)}. A second, long, linear grid with the same time step carries ghosts, echoes and gas-line tails next to the main nonlinear grid (docs/reference/delayed-light.md) |

## Physics

`run.physics`.

Physics switches (docs/reference/run-spec.md#physics).

| key | type | unit | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `nonlinear` | boolean |  | true | Master switch for nonlinear propagation |
| `selfSteepening` | boolean |  | true | Self-steepening |
| `raman` | boolean |  | true | Delayed (Raman) response of materials that have one |
| `fieldMode` | `"auto"` \| `"envelope"` \| `"carrier"` |  | auto | Envelope or carrier-resolved (real field) propagation |
| `fieldHarmonic` | number |  | 3 | Highest harmonic the carrier-resolved grid holds |
| `absoluteIndex` | boolean |  | true | Add air dispersion to air paths quoted relative to air |
| `polarization` | `"jones"` \| `"scalar"` |  | jones | Jones (two polarisations) or scalar |
| `losses` | boolean |  | true | false removes flat loss terms |
| `beamTracking` | any |  | "auto" | Gaussian beam (q) tracking: "auto" (on with a Gaussian inputBeam), "on", "off" |
| `spatioTemporal` | any |  | "auto" | Spatio-temporal couplings (angular / spatial dispersion, pulse-front tilt) with the tracked beam: "auto" (tracked, and their group-delay dispersion applied unless an element has traced groupDelayS), "on", "track" (reported only), "off" (docs/reference/components.md#spatio-temporal-couplings) |
| `transverse` | object (`transverse`) |  |  | Default spatial model for every bulk/gap/crystal without one |
| `ionization` | any |  | false | Photo-ionisation and plasma in every nonlinear bulk element: true or an ionization object |

Also accepts: `gainCommon` (see *Common key groups*).

| `passes` | integer |  | 4 | Passes (multipass) |
| `betweenPasses` | object (`betweenPasses`) |  |  | loss, gddFs2, todFs3, materials |

### `fiber` (also `fibre`, `waveguide`)

A single-mode fibre or waveguide: Taylor betas, a dispersion curve or a material; gamma or n2 + effective area; loss; gain; Raman; soliton and dispersive-wave diagnostics. More: [fibers.md](fibers.md)

| key | type | unit | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `lengthM` | number | m |  | Fibre length **Required.** |
| `betas` | number or array | s^k/m |  | Taylor coefficients [beta2, beta3, ...] at referenceWavelengthM (SI) |
| `betasPsKm` | number or array | ps^k/km |  | Taylor coefficients [beta2, beta3, ...] in ps^k/km (pyNLO / fibre-datasheet units) |
| `referenceWavelengthM` | number | m | the carrier | Wavelength of the Taylor expansion |
| `dispersion` | object (`fiberDispersion`) |  |  | Dispersion curve {wavelengthsM, dPsNmKm \| beta2S2PerM} (alternative to betas) |
| `material` | string |  |  | Bulk material for the dispersion (alternative to betas) |
| `effectiveIndex` | number |  | 1.45 | Mode index at the reference (sets only the absolute phase / group delay) |
| `gamma` | any | 1/(W m) |  | Nonlinear coefficient: a number, or an expression in z (m) for a tapered fibre |
| `n2` | number | m^2/W | 2.6e-20 | Nonlinear index (with effectiveAreaM2 or modeFieldDiameterM, instead of gamma) |
| `effectiveAreaM2` | number | m^2 | 1e-11 with gamma | Effective mode area |
| `modeFieldDiameterM` | number | m |  | Mode-field diameter (A_eff = pi MFD^2 / 4) |
| `lossDbPerKm` | number | dB/km | 0 | Propagation loss |
| `loss` | object (`fiberLossTable`) |  |  | Loss vs wavelength {wavelengthsM, dbPerKm} (alternative) |
| `gainDbPerM` | number | dB/m | 0 | Flat (small-signal) gain |
| `gain` | object (`fiberGain`) |  |  | Gain spectrum {wavelengthsM, dbPerM, outputEnergyJ \| outputPowerW} |
| `raman` | any |  | "silica" | Raman model: "silica" (Blow-Wood), "linAgrawal", "hollenbeck", "none" / false, or a delayed-response model |
| `ramanFraction` | number |  | the model's (0.18; Lin-Agrawal 0.245) | Raman fraction |
| `nonlinear` | boolean |  | true | false forces linear propagation |
| `selfSteepening` | boolean |  | run setting | Self-steepening (optical shock) |
| `timeResponse` | model (timeResponse) |  |  | An extra time-domain response n(t, I) |
| `replaceKerr` | boolean |  | false | true switches off the built-in Kerr/Raman |
| `ionization` | any |  | false | Photo-ionisation (hollow-core gas fibres): true or an ionization object |

Third-order (SHG-gated) cross-correlator: high-dynamic-range contrast with noise floor, resolution, scan grid, polarisation. More: [instruments.md#crosscorrelator](instruments.md#crosscorrelator)

| key | type | unit | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rangeS` | number or array | s | the simulated window | [min, max] delay scan (relative to the peak) |

## Common instrument keys

Keys every instrument accepts (core and plugins).

### `core`

Keys every instrument accepts.

| key | type | unit | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `kind` | string |  |  | Instrument kind **Required.** |
| `name` | string |  | kind_at | Name in the results (unique; repeated names get _2, _3) |
| `at` | string |  | "end" | "input", an element id (after that element) or "end" |
| `sampling` | object (`sampling`) |  |  | What part of the beam the instrument sees: near / far field, pinhole, fibre, slit (non-imaging instruments) |
| `beam` | model (beam) |  |  | Beam model for 1-D locations (cameras, sampling): the instrument images this ideal Gaussian |
| `filter` | model (filter) |  |  | Spectral transmission in front of the instrument (optics, detector spectral response): applied to the field before it is measured |
| `detector` | any |  |  | Read-out of the recorded trace / readings: an object (calibration, noise, noise floor, bit depth, saturation, spectral response) or the name of a preset from the run spec's detectors, or {preset: name \| file, ...overrides} |
| `axis` | object (`instrumentAxis`) |  |  | Where a curve instrument takes its readings: explicit points or from / to / step, bin (pixel) width, Gaussian resolution |
| `measured` | object (`measured`) |  |  | Recorded data to compare this instrument with: a file name (CSV, NPZ, JSON), or an object (file, columns, normalize, sigma, background, rangeX, units, values, weight, resolutionM / resolutionS). docs/reference/measured-data.md |

| `centerYM` | number | m | 0 | Aperture centre y |
| `na` | number |  | 0.22 | Fibre numerical aperture |

### `samplingWavelengths`

Sampling wavelengths of per-wavelength arrays.

| key | type | unit | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `wavelengthsM` | number or array | m |  | Wavelengths |
| `wavelengthsNm` | number or array | nm |  | Wavelengths in nm (alternative) |

### `sensor`

A camera sensor.

Also accepts: `sensorFlat` (see *Common key groups*).

No parameters of its own.

### `transverse`

Spatial model of an element (docs/reference/spatial-models.md).

| key | type | unit | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `model` | `"none"` \| `"radial"` \| `"cartesian"` |  | none | Representation |
| `points` | integer |  | 64 | Radial samples (cartesian: nx = ny if omitted) |
| `nx` | integer |  |  | Cartesian samples in x |
| `ny` | integer |  |  | Cartesian samples in y |
| `radiusM` | number | m | extentFactor x expected radius | Radial grid extent |
| `halfWidthM` | number | m |  | Cartesian half-width |
| `halfWidthXM` | number | m |  | Cartesian half-width in x |
| `halfWidthYM` | number | m |  | Cartesian half-width in y |
| `extentFactor` | number |  | 3.5 | Grid extent / expected beam radius |
| `paraxial` | boolean |  | false | Paraxial diffraction operator instead of the exact one |
| `transport` | `"auto"` \| `"exact"` \| `"rescale"` \| `"beam"` |  | auto | How a profile from before is brought in |
| `initialProfile` | object (`initialProfile`) |  |  | The field at the first spatial element |
| `polarization` | `"auto"` \| `"scalar"` \| `"vector"` |  | auto | Jones (vector) fields on the grid: auto = when the beam carries a y component |
| `equation` | `"envelope"` \| `"uppe"` |  | envelope | Nonlinear coupling: paraxial envelope, or UPPE (n omega / c k_z per plane wave) |
| `spectralSamples` | integer |  | 48 | Frequencies at which the transverse profile is stored and (linear elements) propagated; fewer is faster for narrowband pulses |
| `absorbingBoundary` | any |  | false | Linear elements: absorb light leaving the grid instead of reflecting / wrapping it -- true (outer 15 %) or {widthFraction}; the absorbed energy is booked as 'grid boundary' (docs/reference/transverse.md#diffraction-and-apertures) |

Models with declared parameters (other kinds are described in [Models](models.md)). Every model object also takes `kind` and optionally `name`, `source`, `reference`.

### delayedResponse / `dampedOscillator`

Single damped oscillator h(t) ~ exp(-t/tau2) sin(t/tau1). More: [nonlinear.md#raman-models](nonlinear.md#raman-models)

| key | type | unit | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `tau1` | number | s |  | Period parameter |
| `tau2` | number | s |  | Damping time |
| `fR` | number |  |  | Raman fraction |
| `anisotropicFraction` | number |  | 0 | Anisotropic share of the response (vector Raman: ellipse rotation, circular light) |

### delayedResponse / `hollenbeck`

Hollenbeck & Cantrell 2002 silica Raman: 13 vibrational modes with intermediate broadening, fR = 0.18. More: [nonlinear.md#raman-models](nonlinear.md#raman-models)

| key | type | unit | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fR` | number |  | 0.18 | Raman fraction |
| `anisotropicFraction` | number |  | 0.25 | Anisotropic share of the response (vector Raman: ellipse rotation, circular light) |

### delayedResponse / `linAgrawal`

Lin & Agrawal 2006 silica Raman: damped oscillator + boson peak (pyNLO's full model), fR = 0.245. More: [nonlinear.md#raman-models](nonlinear.md#raman-models)

| key | type | unit | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fR` | number |  | 0.245 | Raman fraction |
| `tau1` | number | s | 12.2e-15 | Oscillator period parameter |
| `tau2` | number | s | 32e-15 | Oscillator damping time |
| `taub` | number | s | 96e-15 | Boson-peak time |
| `fa` | number |  | 0.75 | Weight a |
| `fb` | number |  | 0.21 | Weight b (boson peak) |
| `fc` | number |  | 0.04 | Weight c |
| `anisotropicFraction` | number |  | (fb + fc): h_b = fc h_a + fb h_b | Anisotropic share of the response (vector Raman: ellipse rotation, circular light) |

### delayedResponse / `silica`

Fused-silica Raman response: Blow-Wood damped oscillator (12.2 / 32 fs), fR = 0.18. More: [nonlinear.md#raman-models](nonlinear.md#raman-models)

| key | type | unit | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `fR` | number |  | 0.18 | Raman fraction |
| `anisotropicFraction` | number |  | 0.25 | Anisotropic share of the response (vector Raman: ellipse rotation, circular light) |
